mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evolution_proposal (tenant_id, asset_type, asset_id, trigger_type, root_evidence_json, policy_json, candidate_patch_json, status, lifecycle_json, creator_id, is_deleted, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{assetType}, #{assetId}, #{triggerType}, #{rootEvidenceJson}, #{policyJson}, #{candidatePatchJson}, #{status}, #{lifecycleJson}, #{creatorId}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM evolution_proposal WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM evolution_proposal WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND asset_type = 'SKILL' AND status = 'TRIAL' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(lifecycle_json, '$.trial.taskPatternKey')) = #{taskPatternKey} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM evolution_proposal WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
